Hi Sean,

We signed up through the self-serve flow and spun up a sandbox yesterday. We're evaluating hosted inference for a customer-facing summarization feature and wanted to book a short walkthrough of the Hosted API (sample prompts, cost/latency tradeoffs, and sandbox best practices).

Ideal window for us is next week in the mornings (PDT) — Tues/Wed/Thu between 9–11am. Can you share availability? Also happy to have a short technical call (15–30m).

A few notes about our stack: Python backend, running on k8s in GCP, currently using an internal tokenized pipeline. We care about latency at 95th percentile.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
